milw.translation: abbr. Milwaukee Road <美国>密尔沃基铁路公司; Milwaukee Route (Chicago, Milwaukee, St Paul & Pacific Railroad) 密尔沃基路线（接芝加哥、密尔沃、基圣保罗和太平洋的铁路）

milwaukee.definition: n. largest city of Wisconsin; located in southeastern Wisconsin on the western shore of Lake Michigan; a flourishing agricultural center known for its breweries
